BuildName.description: A valid build name: lowercase letters, digits, '-' and '.', starting and ending on a letter or digit, without '..'.

CheckName.description: A valid check name: lowercase letters, digits, '-' and '.', starting and ending on a letter or digit, without '..'.

Component.description: A part of the repository that is a unit of its own.

allow-unused.description: Checks that may find nothing without failing, each with its reason.

path.description:
Where it lives. May name a single file when exactly that file is the
unit.

versioning.description: Which units around it carry a version.

ComponentDefaults.description: What `[repo.component]` offers. Only a pipeline, and only on request.

pipeline.description: The pipeline a component receives when it asks for it.

EcosystemName.description: A valid ecosystem name: lowercase letters, digits, '-' and '.', starting and ending on a letter or digit, without '..'.

Exclusion.description:
An entry that takes something out of the check.

Two fields instead of a key against a value: the entry names something and
justifies it, and both belong visibly named. Being a table also keeps it
open — were a third field ever to arrive, the shape would not have to be
rebuilt for it.

path.description:
What it applies to.

In a repository's own file only a concrete path, so that is what the
schema of that file allows; the central defaults may name a pattern.

ExplicitPipeline.description: A pipeline written out rather than named.

build.description: The build that produces the artifact.

check.description: Checks beyond the base set every repository runs.

dependabot.description:
The ecosystems Dependabot watches for this unit.

A list, because a unit can have several — a service has its language
ecosystem and its container.

version.description:
The version writers that receive the unit's version as a derived copy.

A list, like `check`: one unit can carry more than one copy.

Inclusion.description:
An entry that pulls something back into the check.

The reason is optional here: adding work is harmless and does not have to
justify itself. The same table shape all the same, so that both directions
look alike and an entry can carry one more field later.

reason.description: Why, if anyone wrote it down.

Pattern.description: A path inside the repository, a type ('*.png') or a name anywhere ('**/LICENSE').

Pipeline.description: What runs for a unit: a preset name, `{ repo = true }` for what `[repo.component]` offers, or the table written out.

PresetName.description: A valid preset name: lowercase letters, digits, '-' and '.', starting and ending on a letter or digit, without '..'.

Publish.description: Where the artifact goes: `false` for nowhere, said out loud, or a list of targets from the central register.

Reason.description: Why, in words. It must say something: a blank reason is an error.

RelativePath.description: A path inside the repository, separated by '/': '.' for the repository itself, never absolute, no '.' or '..' segment.

allow-unused.description: Checks that may find nothing without failing, each with its reason.

component.description: The default a component can ask for with `pipeline.repo = true`.

versioning.description: Which units around it carry a version.

TargetName.description: A valid target name: lowercase letters, digits, '-' and '.', starting and ending on a letter or digit, without '..'.

VersionWriterName.description: A valid version writer name: lowercase letters, digits, '-' and '.', starting and ending on a letter or digit, without '..'.

Versioning.description:
Which units around a declaring unit carry a version.

Every value names the whole effect rather than half of it, so that reading
one tells you whether the declaring unit itself is included.

oneOf.description: This unit and each folder directly below it.
This unit and each file directly below it.
Only the folders directly below it.
Only the files directly below it.
None of them; only units written out separately carry a version.

component.description: Components, keyed by the name that also becomes their tag prefix.

exclude.description:
What falls out of the coverage check, each with its reason.

In the declaration of a repository only concrete paths are allowed here:
a pattern would excuse a whole class of files, and extensions are
decided by the central list.

include.description: What is pulled back into the check — paths and patterns.

repo.description:
The repository itself, which is a unit like any other.

It is required: a file without it would not be a statement, and the
point of demanding the file everywhere is to tell "nothing is published
here" apart from "nobody ever set this up".
